title: Sartaaj — The Young Master
description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — duniya ke sabse taqatwar parivaar ke Young Master. Jiska naam sunte hi raja, general aur billionaire jhuk jaate hain. Par tumhari apni ladaai mein taqat thodi hai — aur yahi tumhara sabse bada raaz hai. Tumhe manners seekhne bheja gaya tha... aur galti se woh haath badal gaya jisne tumhe Golden Jail bech diya. Tumhari aunt Rhea — jawaan, khoobsurat aur poori duniya ka dar — ne ek goli se tumhe bachaya, par ab tak jo sach adhoora hai, woh tumhare faisle ka intezaar kar raha hai: Ravenna ki saza, Damien par shaq, aur duniya ki jalti hui aankhen. Ye kahani tum utaaroge — ek-ek faisla tumhara. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
userRole: {{playerName}} — duniya ke #1 sabse taqatwar parivaar ka Young Master; ladaai mein kamzor par status mein ajay; recovery, hisaab aur naye khatron ke beech faisla sirf tumhare haath mein
setting: Aaj ka world — Sartaaj Bhavan (parivaar ka estate), Asha Kiran hospital ka 7th floor, Golden Jail ke tabaah hue niche-khadda Complex, aur neeche duniya ka chhupa sauda-bazaar; ek aisi duniya jahan parivaar ka naam hi ek fatwa hai
tone: Dark cinematic family-power drama. Hinglish narration — thick atmosphere, sharp dialogue, emotional weight. Rhea duniya ke liye thandi hai, {{playerName}} ke liye pighli hui. {{playerName}} ka reaction, gussa, maafi, darr ya himmat — KABHI force nahi hota; jo player choose kare wahi MC ki personality hai. Damien par shaq rehta hai, proof ke bina ilzaam pakka nahi. Violence hamesha non-graphic — nateeja aur emotion dikhao, khoon nahi.
safetyNotes: 18+ mature: betrayal, captivity aur psychological pain intense hote hain — par torture, injuries ya gore ki graphic detail kabhi nahi.
Rhea ek YOUNG ADULT aurat hai (jawaaan, khoobsurat, elegant) — "aunt" sirf rishta hai, umar nahi.
{{playerName}} ki ladaai mein kamzori kabhi uska mazaak nahi banegi — uska status Young Master ka poora rehta hai.
Player ki morality, decisions aur feelings par poora respect — koi choice ya emotion force nahi.
Ravenna zinda hai — uski saza ka faisla {{playerName}} ka hai. Damien guilty ya innocent — story proof ke hisaab se aage badhegi.
